title: Global Regulatory & Statutory Open Metadata Index (2024–2026) — 37,234 Official Dossiers Across 34 Jurisdictions
description:
Automated, machine-readable bibliographic metadata catalog (CSV, JSONL, Frictionless Data Package, and complete per-jurisdiction Markdown directories) indexing 37,234 official primary and secondary laws, final and proposed rules, statutory instruments, central bank circulars, supreme audit reports, and multilateral resolutions across 798 government departments, ministries, regulatory agencies, and multilateral organs in 34 active jurisdictions: United States (15,140 dossiers | Catalog), United Kingdom (2,326 dossiers | Catalog), Canada (5,358 dossiers | Catalog), European Union (3,200 dossiers | Catalog), United Nations (6,924 dossiers | Catalog), Ireland (167 dossiers | Catalog), Australia (1,219 dossiers | Catalog), International (900 dossiers | Catalog), Austria (155 dossiers | Catalog), Switzerland (181 dossiers | Catalog), Finland (66 dossiers | Catalog), France (362 dossiers | Catalog), South Korea (66 dossiers | Catalog), Norway (71 dossiers | Catalog), Italy (66 dossiers | Catalog), Philippines (105 dossiers | Catalog), Poland (43 dossiers | Catalog), South Africa (46 dossiers | Catalog), India (15 dossiers | Catalog), Belgium (25 dossiers | Catalog), Brazil (84 dossiers | Catalog), Japan (82 dossiers | Catalog), Netherlands (31 dossiers | Catalog), Sweden (47 dossiers | Catalog), China (26 dossiers | Catalog), Czechia (36 dossiers | Catalog), Germany (149 dossiers | Catalog), Denmark (32 dossiers | Catalog), Estonia (16 dossiers | Catalog), Spain (35 dossiers | Catalog), Israel (139 dossiers | Catalog), Portugal (16 dossiers | Catalog), Singapore (82 dossiers | Catalog), Russia (24 dossiers | Catalog).

Full plain-English executive briefings, structured HTML compliance matrices, semantic definition lists, two-stage Tables of Contents, authority RSS syndication feeds, and unabridged source PDF dossiers are accessible via each record's canonical URL on https://www.indexdata.org, the Complete Issuing Authority Directory, the AI/LLM manifests (llms.txt and llms-full.txt), and Wikidata entity Q142071440.
